Vi.summary: She reaches you easily, which is bad for you. With precise timing you can drop your E minefield on her dash and knock her away with W.

Nunu.summary: He can chase you down, but it costs him a lot to do so, and he is not much of a threat otherwise.

Twitch.summary: Once he is revealed he dies quickly. Keep your laners informed of his position, since his plan is to spam cheese ganks.

Kayn.summary: He is weak early, so invade him and win the fights he takes. Respect him more once he has transformed.

RekSai.summary: She knocks you up and kills you before you can cast, and she is hard to kill even when you do get your spells off.

JarvanIV.summary: Keep your distance and only go in after he misses his E-Q combo.

XinZhao.summary: Plays much like Rek'Sai: he gets on you fast and bursts you before you can respond, so keep your distance.

Khazix.summary: Avoid him; he is extremely dangerous to you, so run when he shows up.

Elise.summary: Her combo is easier to land than yours and a good Elise can rappel out of it. Wait for her to make a mistake before fighting.

Ekko.summary: Your E can catch his first dash but not his blink, and he is generally hard to hit. If you do land your spells, he goes down easily.
